entity_name.rationale: EntityName/BusinessNameLine1Txt maps to the primary legal name of the entity making the election at the top of the form.

employer_identification_number.rationale: EntityEIN is the canonical element for the EIN of the entity making the election, distinct from parent or owner EINs.

entity_address_line1.rationale: USAddress/AddressLine1Txt maps to the street address of the entity's domestic mailing address.

entity_address_line2.rationale: USAddress/AddressLine2Txt maps to the second address line of the entity's domestic mailing address.

entity_city.rationale: USAddress/CityNm maps to the city of the entity's domestic mailing address.

entity_state.rationale: USAddress/StateAbbreviationCd maps to the two-letter state code of the entity's domestic mailing address.

entity_zip.rationale: USAddress/ZIPCd maps to the ZIP code of the entity's domestic mailing address.

entity_country.rationale: ForeignAddress/CountryCd maps to the country for entities with a foreign mailing address; however the blueprint bundles domestic and foreign addresses — the canonical schema splits them into USAddress vs ForeignAddress groups, so this field only applies when the entity has a foreign address.

foreign_country_of_organization.rationale: OrganizationCountryCd directly represents the country under whose laws the foreign eligible entity is organized.

election_type.rationale: The blueprint bundles 'initial classification' vs 'change of classification' into one category field, but the canonical schema splits these into two separate boolean indicators (InitialClassificationInd and ChangeInCurrentClsfInd); the blueprint should be refactored into two boolean fields to align with the canonical shape.

requested_classification.rationale: The blueprint uses a single category field for the elected classification, but the canonical schema represents each option as a separate boolean indicator (USAssocTxblAsACorpInd, USEntityAsAPrtshpInd, USEntityOwnerDsrgdSepEntityInd, ForeignEntityTxblAsACorpInd, ForeignPartnershipInd, FrgnOwnerDsrgdSepEntityInd); the blueprint should be refactored into six boolean fields.

single_owner_name.rationale: OwnerName/BusinessNameLine1Txt maps to the name of the single owner when the entity elects disregarded status.

single_owner_identifying_number.rationale: The blueprint bundles SSN and EIN into one field, but the canonical schema provides two separate elements (SSN and EIN); the blueprint should be refactored into two fields to match the canonical split.

single_owner_id_type.rationale: The canonical schema implicitly encodes owner ID type by using separate SSN vs EIN elements rather than a type indicator field; no standalone type indicator candidate exists, so this blueprint field has no direct match.

election_effective_date.rationale: ElectionEffectiveDt directly maps to the requested effective date of the classification election.

more_than_one_owner.rationale: MultipleOwnerYesOrNoInd maps to the checkbox indicating whether the entity has more than one owner.

consenting_owners.rationale: The consent/signature block is not represented as a structured repeating element in the canonical MeF schema for Form 8832; no matching candidate exists.

part_ii_applicable.rationale: There is no standalone boolean indicator for whether Part II is applicable in the canonical schema; late election relief is indicated indirectly via LateClsfReliefRevProc200941Ind or LateClsfReliefRevProc201032Ind, so the blueprint field has no direct single match.

late_election_relief_entity_name.rationale: The canonical schema does not have a separate entity name element under Part II late election relief; the top-level EntityName is reused, so no distinct candidate matches this blueprint field.

late_election_relief_ein.rationale: The canonical schema does not expose a distinct EIN element specifically for Part II late election relief separate from the top-level EntityEIN; no candidate matches.

late_election_relief_requested_date.rationale: No distinct late-election-relief effective date element exists in the candidate list separate from ElectionEffectiveDt; no unambiguous match can be made.

late_election_relief_reason.rationale: LateFiledEntyClsElectnExplnTxt maps to the free-form explanation for why the entity failed to file the election on a timely basis in Part II.

preparer_name.rationale: ContactPersonNm is the closest available candidate for a person's name on the form; however, if it strictly represents an entity contact rather than a paid preparer, there may be a mismatch — the canonical schema appears to lack a dedicated paid-preparer name element.

preparer_ptin.rationale: No PTIN element exists in the candidate list for Form 8832; the canonical schema does not expose a paid-preparer PTIN field.

preparer_self_employed.rationale: No self-employed checkbox indicator for the paid preparer exists among the canonical candidates.

preparer_signature_date.rationale: No paid preparer signature date element exists in the candidate list for Form 8832.

preparer_firm_name.rationale: No preparer firm name element exists among the canonical candidates for Form 8832.

preparer_firm_ein.rationale: No preparer firm EIN element exists among the canonical candidates for Form 8832.

preparer_firm_address.rationale: No preparer firm address element exists among the canonical candidates; the canonical schema does not expose paid preparer firm address fields for this form.

preparer_firm_city.rationale: No preparer firm city element exists among the canonical candidates for Form 8832.

preparer_firm_state.rationale: No preparer firm state element exists among the canonical candidates for Form 8832.

preparer_firm_zip.rationale: No preparer firm ZIP element exists among the canonical candidates for Form 8832.

preparer_phone.rationale: ContactPersonPhoneNum is the closest phone number candidate, though it may represent the entity contact rather than a paid preparer phone; no dedicated paid-preparer phone element exists in the candidate list.
